description: Defines the interface for FreeType CID font services, including function pointer types, service structure, and macros for defining service instances.

methods.name: FT_CID_GetRegistryOrderingSupplementFunc
methods.description: Function pointer type for retrieving registry, ordering, and supplement info for CID fonts.

methods.name: FT_CID_GetIsInternallyCIDKeyedFunc
methods.description: Function pointer type for checking if a face is internally CID keyed.

methods.name: FT_CID_GetCIDFromGlyphIndexFunc
methods.description: Function pointer type for obtaining CID from a glyph index.

methods.name: FT_DEFINE_SERVICE
methods.description: Macro to define a CID service structure with function pointers.

methods.name: FT_DEFINE_SERVICE_CIDREC
methods.description: Macro to define or initialize a CID service record, depending on configuration.
